description: Pearson chi-square test of independence for an r x c table of counts (2x2 up to 10x10), with Yates' correction for 2x2 tables and the G-test: statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, expected counts, adjusted residuals, Cramér's V, whether Cochran's rule for the approximation holds, and Fisher's exact test when the table is 2x2. Empty rows and columns are dropped and reported.

table.description: Rows of whole-number counts, for example [[20, 15], [30, 35]].

name: chi_square_test
title: Chi-square test of independence
